method: Same Sharp decoder and Lanczos3 resize for both immutable AVIFs; manual sRGB alpha composite after resize; nearest integer CSS raster dimensions. No browser rasterization or claimed perceptual pass threshold. Asset-only, no CSS title overlays or corner masks. Contact sheet uses largest actual desktop CSS dimensions, metrics include all six modes. DPR recorded but CSS-space comparison avoids weighting phones more heavily merely for device-pixel density.
